Tables retrieved on 2026-10-23 for the reported missing-data recovery. Layout/navigation and presentation attributes omitted; original statistical cell text retained. Team tables include the total, relief and inning totals used by the parser.

- NF3 DeNA team: https://nf3.sakura.ne.jp/Central/DB/t/teamdata.htm
- NF3 Softbank team: https://nf3.sakura.ne.jp/Pacific/H/t/teamdata.htm
- NF3 DeNA pitchers: https://nf3.sakura.ne.jp/php/stat_disp/stat_disp.php?y=0&leg=0&tm=DB&fp=1&dn=1&dk=0
- NF3 Softbank pitchers: https://nf3.sakura.ne.jp/php/stat_disp/stat_disp.php?y=0&leg=1&tm=H&fp=1&dn=1&dk=0
- Sportsnavi DeNA pitchers: https://baseball.yahoo.co.jp/npb/teams/3/pitchingstats
- Sportsnavi Softbank pitchers: https://baseball.yahoo.co.jp/npb/teams/12/pitchingstats

The official completed-season team pitching totals were independently checked at https://npb.jp/bis/2026/stats/tmp_c.html and https://npb.jp/bis/2026/stats/tmp_p.html. Both pages state 全日程終了. Their fixed totals validate the complete NF3 pitcher roster and the starter/reliever split. Sportsnavi's currently listed roster omits some departed players, so its rows are matched individually rather than incorrectly summing it into a complete team total.
